newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Shell to invest $2.5 bln in Bangladesh gas sector.
newsitem.headline: Shell to invest $2.5 bln in Bangladesh gas sector.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell Group has proposed to the Bangladesh government a $2.5 billion investment in a project to covert natural gas into petroleum products, the company's local office announced in Dhaka on Thursday.
"We are projecting to produce at least 50,000 barrels a day. So, initially we can even export petroleum," Siraj-ud Dowla, Magaging Director of the Shell Company of Bangladesh, told Reuters.
Shell to invest $2.5 bln in Bangladesh gas sector
Dowla said the company was prepared to set up the plant in the next two-and-half years "if the proposal immediately gets government's approval."

The company said the proposed project could replace Bangladesh's entire imports of refined petrolem products including diesel and kerosene oil, for the next five to 10 years. Bangladesh currently imports anb average of 30,000 barrels of refined petroleum products a day.

An eight-member team from the Shell Exploration & Production International ventures from Holland and London visited Bangladesh last week and made their proposal to energy ministry officials. The team also discussed the proposal with the Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, company officials said.
Bangladesh has proven gas reserves of 10.2 trillion cubic feet. Dowla said his company alone has discovered 12 fields, including the biggest Bakhrabad gasfield.
